candidates.hook: Gerald taunts, 'Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief,' as Juliana furiously accuses him of framing them out of jealousy.
candidates.cliffhanger: The Constable pulls Gerald's gold pocket watch directly out of Alexander's coat, leaving Juliana in sheer horror and Alexander realizing he has been framed.
candidates.why: High emotional stakes—starts with bitter class tension and escalates straight into the dramatic twist of the planted evidence.

candidates.hook: Gerald snarls the central conflict: 'Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!'
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander unexpectedly demands 'Search it. Let them,' right as the armed Constable forcefully barges past Juliana into their home.
candidates.why: Establishes the antagonist instantly with a shocking false accusation and builds tense anticipation over what the search will uncover.

candidates.hook: Juliana desperately blocks the doorway, shouting, 'You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!'
candidates.cliffhanger: The officer pulls the stolen watch from Alexander's coat, ending right on Juliana's horrified gasp and Alexander's dark realization.
candidates.why: Covers the full invasion of privacy, the villain's taunting provocation, and the devastating frame-up reveal.

moments.desc: Gerald arrives with an armed constable and accuses Juliana's husband of grand theft.
Gerald insults Alexander as a beggar, provoking a deadly threat from the ex-soldier.
The Constable pulls the gold watch from Alexander's coat, landing the frame-up.
